scripts.text:
^3355FFJust a minute!
I can't offer any of my
services to you because
you're carrying too much
stuff. Put your extra items in
Kafra Storage and come again~
scripts.translation:
^3355FF请稍等！
因为你携带的物品过多，
我无法为你提供这项服务。
请将多余物品存入卡普拉仓库，
然后再来找我~

scripts.text:
[Milk Vendor]
Hey, hey...
If you bring me
1 Empty Bottle and
15 Zeny, I'll exchange
them for 1 Milk. How
does that sound?
scripts.translation:
[卖牛奶的人]
嘿，嘿...
如果你给我
1个空瓶和
15 Zeny，
我会把它们换成1瓶牛奶。
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Milk Vendor]
Hey...
You don't have
any Empty Bottles.
I can't really give you
this milk any other
way, you know...
scripts.translation:
[卖牛奶的人]
嘿...
你没有空瓶。
我没法用其他方式
给你这瓶牛奶，你知道吗...

scripts.text:
[Milk Vendor]
Oh, whoa~!
You don't have enough
zeny to exchange all
these Empty Bottles for
Milk. You need to have
at least {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卖牛奶的人]
哦，天哪~！
你的Zeny不够兑换
所有这些空瓶换牛奶。
你至少需要{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Milk Vendor]
Hmm...
Would you make
a little more room
in your inventory
before I give you
all of this milk?
scripts.translation:
[卖牛奶的人]
嗯...
在我给你所有这些牛奶之前，
你能在背包里
腾出一点空间吗？
